content: People Also Ask is a feature in Bing search result page where related questions are recommended to the user. User may click on a question to view the answer. Clicking is a positive feedback that shows user's interest in the question. We use this click logs to build a question classifier using the same model in Figure 3. The problem statement is very similar to BIBREF10 where they use logistic regression to predict whether an user would click on ad. Our goal is to classify if a question is potential high-click question or not for a given query. For this, we first create a labelled data set using the click logs where any question having CTR lower than 0.3 is labelled as 0 and a question having CTR more than 0.7 as 1.
